plugin_sdk_v1.scope: Versioned native SDK consumer; host-owned atomic document/scene publication; exact simple polyline cache/picking. Does not close the full module.
limitations: 2 unrelated broad app dock reset regressions remain failing

sdk_integration_plan.scope_rule: All SDK-eligible child L3 are delivered with their public adapter; host-internal/governance work records an explicit reason instead of exposing private state.

baseline.qualification: Planning baseline only; source presence and runtime metadata are not new execution evidence.

sdk_integration_plan.owner_specific_task: Read objects/layers đã có; xuất setters/query/attributes với permissions, không cấp mutable Document.
tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Public SDK v1 export of the document owner's read/write attribute services: a filtered paged object query with generation and geometry/attributes revisions, one object attribute record, one staged attribute edit and one staged rename. The host evaluates staged records with Document::permissions_for_attributes (the same layer chain the application uses) and emits Mutation::Attributes/Mutation::Label; no mutable Document crosses the ABI.
l3_open: a layer created in the same command cannot receive newly added objects
groups, blocks/instances, jewellery extension records, change notification, snapshot/restore and import provenance have no plugin surface
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: One command stages at most one of transform, attributes or rename per object (the document transaction allows one source write per object). Attribute edits require an editable layer; object-level locked/hidden stay editable. This record does not close the L2 or its other child L3.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Public SDK v1 export of the document owner's layer service: create a layer (optional make-current), rename/recolour/reflag one layer, select or clear the current layer, and assign existing or already staged objects to an existing or this-command-created layer. Plans are LayerAction/LayerPlan captured through the coordinator; staged layer records are evaluated with Document::layer_permissions_with and permissions_for_attributes_with.
l3_open: groups, blocks/instances, change notification, snapshot/restore and import provenance have no plugin surface
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: One layer write per layer per command. Adding objects to a layer whose flags change in the same command, and assigning objects off such a source layer, are refused by the application's permission-read rule. Assignment is an attribute write, so it conflicts with a transform, attribute edit or rename of the same object.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Same-command output into a layer this command creates: the transaction insert admission resolves the proposed layer record and its captured parent chain, so layer_create(make_current) followed by add_object publishes one transaction and one Undo unit. The permission-read overlap excludes only layers created by that request; a layer whose flags change in the same request still refuses output.
l3_open: Mutation::Publish and cross-document Move keep base-layer validation
groups, blocks/instances, change notification, snapshot/restore and import provenance have no plugin surface
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Only the insert path into a proposed layer is admitted. The anti-bypass rule for captured layers (flags changing in the same request) is unchanged.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Object extension slots read/write: verbatim JSON-object payload with a positive version, bounded slot name, merged staged reads and Mutation::Extension write under the one-source-write-per-object rule. An object created in the same command must be tagged next command.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Payloads are opaque text; schema/version meaning stays with the plugin.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Object placement write: one affine matrix (row-major local->world) through Mutation::Placement, validated by Transform::validate, under the one-source-write-per-object rule; Undo restores the previous matrix.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: One object's matrix only; instance/block transforms remain open.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Polygon mesh creation: add_mesh publishes vertices/faces through Mesh::validate and the shared output path; an out-of-range index is a mesh refusal; one transaction/Undo.

Recorded change feed: one bounded batch per plugin command, real from/to revisions, entity/layer entries, readable by the next plugin command. Host-command recording beyond the plugin boundary is documented as open.
Layer order read (bottom to top), including a layer created by the same command.
Feed covers plugin commands plus host Undo/Redo with real revisions and cause.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Plugin commands and host Undo/Redo only.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Group records read (id/name/members/revision).
Block definition read (id/label/member count/revision).
Clear current layer (no-op when already clear).
Object placement read (base or staged matrix).
Single object record read (same ObjectInfo as query).
Group creation from existing members (one transaction/Undo).
Group delete (record only; one Undo restores).
Single layer record read via the shared list mapping (host-tested).
Native command + DLL test for layer_info closes the previous host-only gap.
Import provenance read (complete chain only; fixed enum strings).
Pickability rule read (effective visible && selectable; locked ignored).
